note: OCT30-INFRA-S013: protected signing of the retained unsigned Models APK by scripts/host-models-sign.py through the PR #149 adapter. Nothing here generates or imports keys; it reads the exact secret versions the protected models-v0 bootstrap committed.

input.basis: S013 selected ingress: only the original unsigned input the PR #149 profile pins (source, push/main, run, attempt), read by the hosted guard with its existing actions: read job token, validated by scripts/models-input-ingress.py before the controller starts, handed to the signing job as a same-run artifact and rechecked there before any secret access. No other run, artifact, URL, credential or permission is accepted.

sdk.basis: MODELS-SDK-PREP-001: an isolated cache, never the shared android-sdk. scripts/setup-android-sdk.sh pins Google's build-tools_r35_linux.zip; the models-sign preflight (before login, under the shared lock) prepares or reuses it with scripts/models-sdk-prepare.py, verifying the digest before extraction and the whole extracted tree after, and the signed run only revalidates it: the retained archive is rehashed and its android-15 subtree must equal the installed build-tools/android-15 tree file by file
